scope: expanded offline TheStatsAPI evidence; separate goals, BTTS and provider-yellow-card model comparisons; corners protected
source_policy: same provider only; preserve source file/hash; exact match_id identity; conflicting finished fixture or stats payloads quarantine the match; no implicit provider blending

walk_forward.scheme: expanding train, fixed calibration, non-overlapping chronological test windows; timestamp groups; 28h purge

optional_xg_model: DEEP_POISSON_XG on support-matched xG cohort only
similar_opponent: separate deterministic arm; pre-fixture opponent defensive profile distance, recency weighted, minimum 5 comparable prior opponents; no invented similarity score enters outside this registered transform
feature_support: exact provider path; missing != zero; period-conflicted cells excluded; no all-missing feature accepted; deep feature must be present for both sides in >=80% of joined raw-stat fixtures before outcomes are scored
calibration: count models use two side multiplicative scales fit only on calibration segment; direct BTTS uses regularized Platt calibration fit only on calibration segment
uncertainty: paired ISO-week block bootstrap; fixture rows grouped; 2000 resamples; fixed seed 3220
market_layer: not used for fitting or model selection; historical market evidence separately audited; unavailable matched quotes => MARKET_UNTESTED
promotion: none; all currently accessible outcomes are development data; prospective shadow evidence required
settlement: inherit V32.1 stable regulation-score gate; append-only corrections
corners: frozen V3 corners model byte-identical; no refit or experiment
anti_adaptation: all arms, features, folds, thresholds and hyperparameters frozen before V32.2 result generation; failed or negative arms retained
